entities.summary: Zoumalou bamboo slips refers to cultural relics that were unearthed at Zoumalou, the urban central area of Changsha, Hunan, China in 1996. The discovery was one of the most important archaeological finds in China during the 1990s. All the historical artifacts from Zoumalou are kept at the Changsha Jiandu Museum. The important archaeological site of Mawangdui is also located in Changsha.
